versions.name: J. Edward Mack Scout Reservation

features.note: Squire Lake, used for boating and fishing.
Canoes alongside paddle boats, rowboats and coracles.
Catch and release on Squire Lake; poles are available at camp.
The dining hall is a pavilion.
A shower house and comfort station near the dining hall and pool.
In the shower house and the Alley Action Center; campsites have pit latrines.
Canvas wall tents on wooden platforms, grouped in pods of three.
One outlet at each campsite latrine, for charging only.
The Outpost overnight, run in the weeklong sessions for Webelos and Arrow of Light Scouts.

versions.summary: Cub Scout resident camp operated by the Pennsylvania Dutch Council at Camp Mack in Newmanstown, Pennsylvania, offering weekend and week-long sessions.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
